challenge.en: DataLoader I/O serialization starved GPU compute during OpenFOAM CFD training.
challenge.zh-TW: DataLoader I/O 序列化阻塞，導致 GPU 在 CFD 訓練期間嚴重閒置飢餓。

solution.en: Rebuilt data loading pipeline and custom PhysicsNeMo format conversion.
solution.zh-TW: 重建訓練資料管線，並自訂 PhysicsNeMo 格式轉換消除 I/O 阻塞。

boundary.en: 10× overall model-training speedup measured on CFD workload.
boundary.zh-TW: 衡量指標：OpenFOAM CFD 工作負載之整體模型訓練速度提升 10 倍。

aInput.en: CFD training GPU compute starved at ~15% utilization
aInput.zh-TW: CFD 訓練 GPU 算力嚴重飢餓（利用率僅約 15%）

weakestLink.en: Python DataLoader I/O serialization & format conversion stall
weakestLink.zh-TW: Python DataLoader 序列化 I/O 與格式轉換阻塞

bOutput.en: 10× overall model-training speedup on identical hardware
bOutput.zh-TW: 既有硬體上釋放 10× 整體模型訓練速度提升

strictInvariant.en: DataLoader streaming throughput must match or exceed GPU compute ingestion rate without dropping CFD cell precision.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: DataLoader 串流吞吐必須匹配或超越 GPU 計算攝取速率，且不得犧牲 CFD 網格計算精度。

zh-TW: 重寫 OpenFOAM C++ 求解器核心
超頻 GPU 硬體頻率

failureConditions.en: If disk I/O latency degrades below PCIe Gen4 standard or host RAM bandwidth saturates, pipeline falls back to cached chunk mode.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 若磁碟 I/O 延遲低於 PCIe Gen4 標準或主機記憶體頻寬飽和，管線降級為快取分塊模式。

challenger.en: Why not simply add more GPU memory or use a distributed cloud cluster to bruteforce the training throughput?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼不直接堆更多 GPU 顯存或使用分散式雲端叢集暴力解決訓練吞吐？

defense.en: First-principles analysis proved the GPU compute utilization was hovering below 15% due to serialization in Python's DataLoader. Adding more GPUs would scale cost linearly while compute starvation remains. Eliminating the I/O bottleneck yielded 10× speedup on identical hardware.
defense.zh-TW: 第一性原理分析證明，GPU 運算利用率低於 15% 的根因在於 Python DataLoader 的序列化 I/O。盲目堆疊 GPU 只會線性膨脹雲端成本，運算飢餓依然存在。擊穿 I/O 弱環節，在既有硬體上即釋放 10× 訓練速度。

challenger.en: Where does this system break first under extreme load?
challenger.zh-TW: 這個架構在極端負載下第一個崩潰的環節是什麼？

defense.en: Host-to-Device (H2D) PCIe bandwidth saturation when CFD mesh cell count exceeds pinned memory pool boundaries. Mitigated via asynchronous double-buffering prefetch.
defense.zh-TW: 當 CFD 網格節點數超出鎖頁記憶體（Pinned Memory）池上限時的 Host-to-Device (H2D) PCIe 頻寬飽和。對策為透過非同步雙緩衝預取機制平滑頻寬波峰。

staff.en: Root-cause pinpointing: DataLoader I/O starvation vs streaming format
staff.zh-TW: 根因定位：DataLoader I/O 飢餓 vs 串流格式重構

coreQuestion.en: Why is GPU compute idling below 15% when memory is plentiful, and where is the critical saturation boundary?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 顯存充足時 GPU 運算利用率為何卡在 15% 以下？系統極限飽和邊界究竟在哪？

breakthrough.en: Deconstructed the PyTorch DataLoader serialization bottleneck; replaced with custom PhysicsNeMo streaming loader and lock-free double-buffering prefetch.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 第一性原理拆解 PyTorch DataLoader 序列化 I/O 阻塞；以自訂 PhysicsNeMo 串流格式與無鎖雙緩衝預取全面替換。

verifiedMoat.en: Maximized hardware compute saturation; smoothed PCIe Host-to-Device transfer peaks with verified 10× model-training speedup.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 實現硬體運算飽和最大化；平滑 PCIe H2D 傳輸峰值，並以實測 10× 訓練提速完成驗證。

failureConditions.en: If factory floor electromagnetic interference exceeds industrial shielding thresholds, hardware bus initiates deterministic fault assertion rather than capturing desynced frames.

challenger.en: Why use a deterministic hardware trigger sync bus instead of software network time protocol (PTP/IEEE 1588)?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼堅持設計硬體觸發同步匯流排，而不直接用軟體網路時間協定（PTP/IEEE 1588）？

defense.en: Software network polling introduces non-deterministic OS kernel scheduling jitter (100μs–1ms) on busy line controllers. At conveyor line speed, 500μs equals millimeter-level optical displacement, ruining 3D stereo calibration. Physical hardware sync lines guarantee sub-microsecond determinism.
defense.zh-TW: 軟體網路輪詢在產線控制器高負載時會引入非確定性的 OS 排程抖動（100μs–1ms）。在輸送帶運轉速度下，500μs 的時序差就等於毫米級的光學位移，摧毀 3D 立體標定精度。實體硬體同步線提供次微秒級確定性保證。

challenger.en: What was the biggest boundary test failure before reaching factory-ready status?
challenger.zh-TW: 在達到工廠上線前測試階段前，最大的邊界測試失敗點是什麼？

defense.en: Thermal drift of camera mounting brackets altering stereo baseline extrinsic matrix after 8 continuous hours of operation. Solved by defining periodic automated validation targets and thermal compensation specs.
defense.zh-TW: 連續運轉 8 小時後，相機支架的熱脹冷縮導致立體基線外參矩陣微幅漂移。透過定義週期性自動標定靶標與熱補償調校規範解決。

staff.en: Deterministic hardware sync bus; sub-microsecond multi-camera trigger invariant
staff.zh-TW: 確定性硬體同步匯流排；次微秒級多相機觸發不變量

failureConditions.en: When user query complexity triggers a plan estimation > 5.0 TALK, execution is blocked at the gate and rerouted to T5 compact mode (4.6) with zero token leakage.

challenger.en: Why build a custom TALK budget gate rather than simply letting an LLM agent summarize with max_tokens set in the API call?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼要自訂 TALK 預算閘門，而不是單純在 API 呼叫中設定 max_tokens 讓 LLM 自己總結？

defense.en: API max_tokens is a blunt truncation mechanism—it cuts output mid-sentence and doesn't prevent wasteful multi-agent recursive exploration upstream. The TALK gate evaluates the execution graph prior to dispatch, enforcing cognitive budgeting and deliberate synthesis routing before billing occurs.
defense.zh-TW: API 的 max_tokens 只是生硬的截斷機制——它會在句子中途切斷，且完全無法防止上游多 Agent 遞迴搜尋的 Token 浪費。TALK 閘門在派發前即評估執行圖預算，在計費產生前強制執行認知預算控管與精簡重導向。

challenger.en: How do you prove that 6.0 → 4.6 isn't just an arbitrary number?
challenger.zh-TW: 如何證明 6.0 → 4.6 不只是隨意捏造的數字？

defense.en: TALK 1.8 is an explicit formal cost model based on input token AST density and reasoning step weights, backed by verifiable JSON-LD receipts in the walkthrough artifact, explicitly scoped as calculated budget rather than wall-clock seconds.
defense.zh-TW: TALK 1.8 是基於輸入 Token AST 密度與推理步權重的形式化成本模型，在歷史流程展示中具備 JSON-LD 數位收據，並在邊界中嚴格界定為計算預算而非真人碼錶時間。

challenger.en: Why not let an LLM directly output the cleanest, most fluent transcript in one single prompt pass?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼不讓 LLM 在一次 Prompt 中直接輸出最流暢乾淨的逐字稿？

defense.en: Single-pass LLM rewriting is inherently destructive. LLMs routinely hallucinate filler word removal, dropping specialized jargon, technical numerals, or subtle verbal hesitations that carry critical legal/technical meaning. The dual-track architecture preserves raw ground truth while presenting edits as non-destructive candidate diffs.
defense.zh-TW: 單步 LLM 改寫本質上是破壞性的。LLM 在去除贅字時常產生幻覺，抹除專用術語、精確數字或代表猶豫的微弱語氣，而這些細節往往具備關鍵法律或技術意涵。雙軌架構守住原始事實真理，所有修改僅作為非破壞性候選差分層呈現。

challenger.en: How does the system ensure privacy on mobile devices?
challenger.zh-TW: 該系統如何在行動裝置端確保使用者隱私？

defense.en: Audio is written to Android's private scoped storage sandbox accessible only by the application UID. ASR runs entirely via on-device Whisper models, requiring zero network permissions for the core transcription pipeline.
defense.zh-TW: 音訊直接寫入 Android 專有沙盒空間（Private Scoped Storage），僅限應用程式 UID 存取。語音辨識完全在本機離線執行，核心轉錄管線完全不需要網路連線權限。
